description: This file implements the 'Eos' class, which manages the end-of-stream (EOS) handling for a media player within a specific task context. It includes methods for constructing, destructing, and executing EOS procedures, including logging and interaction with GStreamer.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: A class that handles the end-of-stream signaling for a media source, managing interactions with GStreamer and updating stream state.

methods.name: Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos object with context, player, GStreamer wrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: ~Eos
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the Eos object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the end-of-stream operation, including canceling underflow if applicable, and signaling GStreamer to end the stream.
